get.summary: Get Analysis Results with Optional Filtering
get.description: Retrieves records from the 'analysis_results' table. Filtered by the organization in the X-User-Organization header. Can be further filtered by optional date range parameters.

parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Starting month (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Ending month (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM.

400.description: Invalid date format or missing header.

error.example: Invalid date format. Please use YYYY-MM.

get.summary: Get KU Statistics for a Specific Developer
get.description: Retrieves the count of unique files where each KU was detected for a single developer within the organization. Filtered by the X-User-Organization header.

parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.description: The name of the developer (author).

schema.description: A dictionary where keys are KU names and values are integer counts.
